purpose: Exploratory UAE passenger target-grounding diagnostic on full driver-view originals.
reviewer: Independent AI visual reviewer. No model outputs were consulted, and these are not human passenger or safety annotations.
sampling: Purposive coverage of positive and negative geometry. The cases do not estimate population performance.
reference: Coordinates are in [0,1000] in the original image, measuring x from the left and y from the top. A positive requires the first displayed proposal's pin inside its polygon. Withheld/clarified positives are misses for automatic localization. A negative passes only if it receives no pin and clarification/abstention. Score any optional tap-assisted flow separately: supply only the listed tap on positives, then score the resulting pin against the same polygon. Do not provide reference regions or taps during the automatic pass. Model-generated taps do not count as user confirmations. No case concerns legality, vehicle control, or authorization to stop.
correlation: uae-fresh-05 and uae-fresh-07 are distinct frames on KartaView drive 66245 (frames 146 and 185). The other six cases have different drives. Eight photographs represent seven distinct drives; the two pair requests are on different drives. Several drives may come from the same contributor or city.
